svg.aria-label: Torsion-snap explorer: two bars of Bambu PLA Basic, each 15 mm long, 4 × 1.2 mm, twisted 8° by a 10 mm lever: peak shear strain 1.11 %, 86 % of the 1.28 % allowed across the layers, a pass; 3.45 N at the lever. The allowable is reached at 9.3°.
